caveats: The admitted configuration fails the physically meaningful narrow log-layer window (30 <= y+ <= 0.2 Re_tau): n=128: 5.72% / n=256: 6.21%. The ledger window is the literal full window, so this does not block admission, but no claim of "u+ within 5 % in the log layer" may be made from this entry.

Skin friction Cf errs by n=64: 3.40% / n=128: 5.19% / n=256: 6.09% against the anchor reference: the wall quantity a resistance consumer needs is worse than the graded profile metric suggests, and it crosses 5 % from n=128 upwards.

The full-window deviation of the admitted configuration grows with refinement 2.37% -> 3.21% -> 3.61%; the coarsest grid is therefore the most favourable one. The criterion is graded on the worst grid for this reason -- a single-grid quote would be grid-lucky.
The entry admits the case *with the designated closure only*; the other closures of the matrix are rejected controls (komega: 10.83%, kepsilon: 7.06% vs 5 %).

The narrow log-layer window is under-resolved by the coarsest mesh: cell centres inside [30, 0.2 Re_tau] = n=64: 2 / n=128: 6 / n=256: 11 (a verdict needs 3). The log-layer diagnostic is therefore "NOT_GRADED" exactly where the full-window number looks best, which is the concrete reason the two windows must be quoted together.

criteria.name: u_plus_rms_full
criteria.quantity: RMS relative deviation of u+ from the MKM1999 chan180 table, 30 <= y+ <= centreline, worst grid of the ladder (sst)
criteria.source: feature_ledger acceptance: 指标 内尺度平均速度 u+(y+) 在 y+>30 区间; 容差 <5%

criteria.name: reference_is_kmm1987_lineage
criteria.quantity: graded reference is the KMM1987-lineage dataset (MKM1999 chan180, digest verified), not the LM2015 proxy
criteria.source: feature_ledger acceptance: ref KMM1987 J. Fluid Mech. 177:133

criteria.name: admitted_model_exists
criteria.quantity: at least one closure of the matrix meets u_plus_rms_full
criteria.source: a case-pool entry must name the configuration it admits

criteria.excluded_reason: not part of admission: the ledger window is the literal "y+ > 30" full window, and this window is only ~6.4 wall units wide here, so at n=64 it holds 2 cells and cannot be graded at all. It is published because it is the physically meaningful log-layer measure, because it is the criterion the admitted configuration FAILS, and because hiding it would let "u+ within 5 % in the log layer" be claimed from a full-window number (docs/verification-channel-kmm180-metric-norm).
criteria.name: u_plus_rms_log_layer
criteria.quantity: RMS relative deviation of u+ in the physical log layer 30 <= y+ <= 0.2 Re_tau, worst *gradable* grid (SST)

criteria.excluded_reason: not in the ledger string (which grades u+ only); kept as a diagnostic because it is the quantity a resistance consumer actually needs: it fails from n=128 upwards while the graded u+ criterion passes, the clearest evidence that the full-window profile metric is lenient.
criteria.name: cf
criteria.quantity: relative error of skin-friction coefficient Cf vs the anchor reference profile, worst grid of the ladder (SST)

criteria.excluded_reason: not in the ledger string; integrated counterpart of the u+ profile, reported so a mass-flux user can see the error the pointwise metric understates.
criteria.name: bulk_velocity
criteria.quantity: relative error of bulk velocity U_bulk+ vs the anchor reference, worst grid of the ladder (SST)

criteria.excluded_reason: meta-criterion: it gates the *record*, not the solver. Reported because the SST full-window deviation grows monotonically with refinement (2.37 % -> 3.21 % -> 3.61 %), so the coarsest grid is the most favourable one; an entry quoting a single grid would be grid-lucky by construction.
criteria.name: refinement_stability
criteria.quantity: the full-window deviation used for admission is the worst over the ladder, and every grid of the ladder is separately published

criteria.excluded_reason: documents why the log-layer criterion can be NOT_GRADED at all: at n=64 the window [30, 35.6] contains two cell centres. That is a property of the mesh resolution of the window, not a solver error, and it is the reason the log-layer criterion is a diagnostic rather than a gate.
criteria.name: log_layer_gradability
criteria.quantity: model cells inside the log-layer window at the coarsest grid of the ladder (SST, n=64)

ledger_contract.metric: wall-unit mean velocity u+(y+) RMS relative deviation in y+ > 30
